notes.title: Patch Notes — Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes — Hotfix 1.0.1[/h1][h3]
🔧 Gameplay & Progression[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted Tier 4 Step "House Building": Cobalt Ore is no longer required. This fixes a progression blocker in the game’s logic.[/p][/*][*][p]Spell Teacher menu now displays a tip on how to assign abilities to slots. This requires building a Spellbinding Table, whose recipe is unlocked through the Obelisk.[/p][/*][*][p]The experience bar at the bottom will no longer be shown once you reach the maximum level.[/p][/*][*][p]The Obelisk now remembers your last selected Step and no longer defaults back to Tier 0 every time.[/p][/*][/list][h3]
🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could die from hunger by accidentally dealing a critical hit to themselves (yes, you read that right).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where client players couldn’t see their Critical Strike chance in the character menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the text "Click to Fast Travel" wasn’t translated into other languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a localization bug where ally nameplates were cut off in certain languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where abilities sometimes couldn’t be used right after finishing their cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Sprint ability could get stuck on clients, leading to severe gameplay issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where allies in Safe Zone could disappear from a client’s screen due to a server sync issue.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]A huge thank you to everyone who shares feedback and reports bugs. Every message helps us polish the game and move forward faster.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022623/95d9ce2bdd8315c42f3808cf866de1b767194b50.png[/img]
Hey everyone!

We've just released a small hotfix, [b]removing the fishing mini-game[/b] based on your feedback. For now, fishing will work without a mini-game.

At the same time, we're working hard on the Early Access version, which will bring more core mechanics, content, and improvements. Right now, our focus is on raids and bosses, making sure they feel exciting and rewarding.

A huge thank you to everyone for your support and feedback - you’re helping us shape Shamania into the best game it can be! 💙

notes.title: Shamania Patch Notes - Version 0.11.4
notes.content:
[h2]Localization:[/h2]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] 🛠️ Fixed an issue where teammates could delete your waypoint by getting close to it.
[*] 🛠️ Fixed a bug where deleting a chest or farm totem wouldn’t drop the items inside.

[*] 🛠️ Fixed CTRL + LMB not working in the farm totem menu.
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] ⏳ Increased the despawn timer for dropped items and enemy loot chests from 5 minutes to 10 minutes.
[*] 🍴 Hunger no longer deals lethal damage (you cannot die from hunger).
[/list]

This update focuses on improving the overall experience and addressing key issues. We’re continuing to refine Shamania and will share more updates soon. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: DevBlog #2
notes.content:
Greetings, friends! We’re excited to share the latest updates and improvements we’ve been hard at work on over the past few weeks.

[h2]New Mechanics and Systems[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Auto-Farm System:[/b] Players can now set up totems for automatic gathering of basic resources. This will ease daily tasks and give you more time to explore the world.
[*][b]Resource Gathering Mini-Game:[/b] We’ve introduced a fun and interactive mini-game to make the gathering process more engaging and rewarding.
[*][b]Progress Saving:[/b] The game now automatically saves not only teleports, splines, and chests but also your tutorial progress, allowing you to pick up right where you left off.
[/list]

[h2]Combat and Profession Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]VFX and SFX Updates:[/b] We’ve added stunning visual effects for attacks and sounds for interactions, making combat and gameplay moments more dynamic and immersive.
[*][b]Herbalism Revamp:[/b] The Herbalism profession has been completely reworked to make it more rewarding and impactful. Discover unique resources, craft rare items, and unlock the hidden secrets of nature!
[/list]

[h2]World and Environment[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Enhanced World Content:[/b] The world is now even more vibrant, featuring new enemies, points of interest, and environmental elements.
[*][b]Spline-Based Construction:[/b] Building fences through splines is now possible, providing more flexibility and convenience for your creations.
[/list]

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
We’re continuing to optimize the game, improve performance, and develop new mechanics.

[i]Thank you for your support and for being a part of this journey![/i] ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: DevBlog #1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, Shamans![/b][/h1]

It's been quite a while since we began developing [b]Shamania[/b], and with every step, the game has become more ambitious and refined. What started as a simple survival idea in an open world has now evolved into a rich gameplay experience, blending crafting, exploration, building, and co-op. Our efforts to create a unique experience are paying off, and we’re excited to share the first significant results with you.

We’ve placed special emphasis on the [b]profession mechanics[/b]. Now, each profession requires not just a click of a button but thoughtful planning. You’ll be selecting materials, refining your skills, and continuously improving your abilities in the game’s various crafts, which will make your gameplay more strategic and diverse.

One of our primary goals was to make [b]co-op gameplay[/b] engaging. We’ve added multiple ways for players to interact with each other, whether through building a base together, fighting, or exploring the world. You can now join your friends and split roles—one gathers resources, another builds, a third crafts equipment—and all of this influences the team's overall success.

We’re also continuing to evolve the building system, ensuring it remains intuitive and enjoyable. Building is no longer just about completing tasks; it’s an opportunity for creativity. You can create not only basic shelters but also complex structures, decorating and fortifying them as you like.

[b][h2]What’s next?[/h2][/b]
We’re constantly improving Shamania and preparing new mechanics to further diversify the gameplay. In the future, you can expect more content, including new professions and crafting opportunities, as well as expanded combat mechanics and unique in-game events.

Our goal is to create a game that inspires players to explore, craft, build, and collaborate in a vast world full of opportunities. We want to thank everyone supporting us on this journey, and we’re looking forward to sharing even more exciting content soon!
